coder_notes: NSCLC plus GBM basket; GBM is eligible only in Phase 1 (named in title, brief summary and the Phase 1 arm label). EGFR alteration is required for the GBM cohort and silevertinib is an EGFR inhibitor, so candidate-matched eligibility. NSCLC EGFR mutations are also required (Phase 2 cohorts) but are not GBM-relevant and are covered by the same biomarker row. Phase 2 Cohort 3 has an empty intervention list in the registry; the brief summary says all patients receive silevertinib, so it is included in arms. Treatment setting coded for the GBM cohort (recurrent); Cohort 3 NSCLC is treatment-naive. PK is plasma only.
